releases.name: v42.0.0
releases.notes:
# [v42.0.0](https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/compare/v41.7.1...v42.0.0) (2026-10-15)

There are 3 breaking changes in this release

**Upgrade Notes**

1. **Kubernetes v1.30+**: The chart now requires Kubernetes v1.30 or higher (https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/pull/2030).
2. **Traefik Hub Secret RBAC**: Write verbs on Secrets (`create`, `update`, `delete`) are no longer granted cluster-wide.
   * A `Role` now grants them in the release namespace only, where Traefik Hub writes its Secrets (https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/pull/2028)
3. **Transparency logs witnesses**: (https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/pull/2018):
   * `hub.transparencyLogs.witnessGroup.witnesses` now defaults to `null` and `threshold` must be at least `1`.
   * Setting `threshold`, `timeout` or `failOpen` without any witness now fails.

> [!NOTE]
> With `hub.token`, the chart now deploys a cluster-scoped `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` that only allows Traefik Hub to write `Opaque` and `kubernetes.io/tls` Secrets.
> Set `hub.restrictSecretTypes: false` if the installer cannot create cluster-scoped resources.

## :boom: BREAKING CHANGES

- fix(tlogs)!: empty witness config #2018 by @LBF38
- feat(chart)!: require Kubernetes v1.30 or higher #2030 by @mloiseleur
- fix(rbac)!: 🐛 scope Traefik Hub secret write permissions to release namespace #2028 by @mloiseleur

## :rocket: Features

- feat(hub): :rocket: support traefik hub v3.20.16 and v3.21.3 #2032 by @mloiseleur
- feat(hub): restrict Secret types written by Traefik Hub #2031 by @mloiseleur

## :bug: Bug fixes

- fix(examples): fix outdated value schema used in `additionalServices` example #2023 by @jnoordsij

## :package: Others

- chore(deps): update github actions #2024 by @renovate-with-github-actions[bot]
- chore(deps): update quay.io/helmpack/chart-testing docker tag to v3.15.0 #2025 by @renovate-with-github-actions[bot]
- docs(agents): document Traefik Hub version bump #2033 by @mloiseleur
- docs(examples): add Traefik Hub Gateway with the Traefik MCP server as a sidecar #2007 by @emilevauge
- chore(release): 🚀 publish 42.0.0 #2034 by @mloiseleur

## 👌 Traefik version support

* Traefik Proxy: v3.6.0 -> v3.7.14 (default)
* Traefik Hub: v3.19.3 -> v3.21.3

# [v41.0.0](https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/compare/v40.3.0...v41.0.0) (2026-06-16)

**Upgrade Notes**

1. **Logs & access logs syntax**: The chart now aligns its logging keys with the upstream Traefik syntax with PR https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/pull/1887.
   * `logs.general` is renamed to `log` (e.g. `logs.general.level` → `log.level`).
   * `logs.access` is renamed to `accessLog` (e.g. `logs.access.format` → `accessLog.format`).
   * Filter and field keys are now camelCased: `filters.statuscodes` → `filters.statusCodes`, `filters.retryattempts` → `filters.retryAttempts`, `filters.minduration` → `filters.minDuration`, and `fields.*.defaultmode` → `fields.*.defaultMode`.
   * The `accessLog.fields.general` nesting level is removed: `fields.general.defaultmode` → `fields.defaultMode`.Expand commentComment on line R27Resolved
2. **File provider content**: `providers.file.content` is now an object (`{}`) instead of a string (`""`).

> [!TIP]
> Image `registry` and `repository` now default to `null`.
> The chart now automatically resolves the full official image URI for both Traefik Proxy and Traefik Hub.

- fix(logs)!: align syntax with upstream #1887 by @mloiseleur

- fix(deployment): omit spec.replicas when replicas is null #1891 by @mloiseleur
